title: Kalıplar 4: İngiliz usulü sohbet
intro: İngilizler sohbeti genelde hava durumu ile açar. “How are you?” gerçek bir soru değil, selamlamadır; kısa ve olumlu cevap verin: “Fine, thanks. And you?” Uzun dertler anlatılmaz.

words.example: Hi Tom! How's it going?
How are things at work?
How are you? — Not bad, thanks.
How's life? — Can't complain.
Lovely weather, isn't it? — Yes, finally some sun!
words.exampleTr: Hava çok güzel, değil mi? — Evet, nihayet biraz güneş!

words.example: Terrible weather today! — I know, it hasn't stopped raining.
words.exampleTr: Bugün hava berbat! — Evet, yağmur hiç durmadı.

words.en: Did you have a good weekend?
words.example: Morning! Did you have a good weekend?
words.exampleTr: Günaydın! Hafta sonun iyi geçti mi?

words.en: What have you been up to?
words.example: Long time no see! What have you been up to?
words.exampleTr: Uzun zaman oldu! Neler yapıyorsun bu aralar?

words.example: Ayşe! Long time no see!
How was your day? — Busy, but good.
words.exampleTr: Günün nasıl geçti? — Yoğun ama iyi.

words.example: Nice to see you again, Mr Brown.
words.exampleTr: Sizi tekrar görmek güzel, Bay Brown.
words.note: ilk tanışmada: Nice to meet you

words.en: What do you do for a living?
words.example: What do you do for a living? — I'm a software developer.
Where are you based? — I'm based in Istanbul.
Have you been here before? — No, it's my first time.
words.exampleTr: Daha önce geldin mi? — Hayır, ilk kez geliyorum.

words.tr: Hafta sonu için planın var mı?
words.example: Any plans for the weekend? — Nothing special.
words.exampleTr: Hafta sonu planın var mı? — Özel bir şey yok.

words.en: It was nice talking to you
words.example: It was nice talking to you. See you around!
Oh, it's late. I'd better get going.
words.exampleTr: Aa, geç olmuş. Artık gitsem iyi olur.

words.example: Bye! Take care.
Thanks! Have a good one.
Bye, see you soon!
I've got to go. Catch you later!
Here's your coffee. — Cheers, mate.
I'm putting the kettle on. Fancy a cuppa?
words.note: British: cuppa = a cup of tea

words.example: There's food in the kitchen. Help yourself.
Come in! Make yourself at home.
words.exampleTr: Gel içeri! Evindeymiş gibi rahat ol.

words.example: Mind the gap between the train and the platform.
words.exampleTr: Tren ile peron arasındaki boşluğa dikkat edin.

words.example: Alright, Mehmet? — Yeah, not bad.
Have a nice weekend! — Same to you!
